q: Wharfage and Demurrage returns should be checked at least ...... in the Traffic Accounts office
e: Option A is correct. Wharfage and demurrage returns must be test-checked in the Traffic Accounts Office at least at the prescribed frequency, since these charges are prone to leakage and under-collection at stations. Demurrage is the charge for detaining wagons beyond free time; wharfage is for occupying goods sheds/sidings beyond free time.
